mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (department_id, full_name, email, password_hash, phone, role, auth_provider, external_subject_id, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{fullName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{authProvider}, #{externalSubjectId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{deleted}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET department_id = #{departmentId}, full_name = #{fullName}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, phone = #{phone}, role = #{role}, auth_provider = #{authProvider}, external_subject_id = #{externalSubjectId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, is_deleted = #{deleted}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
